verdicts.reason: A: the photo floats in empty white space at the top, the orange text band is in the middle, and the search icon has come loose from its bar and sits greyed out in a dead white area at the bottom. The search bar's icon cell is left empty, and the headline order is flipped (ONLINE COURSE comes before HOW TO LEVEL UP). B: keeps the original's orange-on-top, photo-below structure and has a strong ONLINE COURSE headline. However, the magnifier has been blown up into a huge, blurry glyph that is detached from the search bar and competes with the headline. The bar's icon cell is also empty. B is still the more cohesive and on-brand of the two.
